decisions.reason: Step 2.1 invoked a supplier restricted to D(A) for arbitrary unit vectors. Repaired it using the PVM domain of f(A), f(lambda)=|lambda|^(1/2), which gives the absolute-first-moment iff for all vectors. The mean is the difference of finite positive and negative integrals. Also corrected F5 to the unbounded self-adjoint definition. Second moments, D(A^2) variance and weighted positive-index integrability were checked; Statement unchanged.

The superposition remark made an unconditional inequality claim. For A=diag(0,1), psi=(e1+e2)/sqrt(2) and rho=(T_e1,e1+T_e2,e2)/2 have identical two-atom laws. Qualified the remark to need not agree, with vanishing interference allowed; Definition (a)-(g), assigned units, domains, Born law, support as probability one, and moment qualifications remain unchanged.

The assigned observable units were implicit rather than declared locally. Added (Q_j,m) and (P_j,kg m s^-1), numeric SI coordinate conventions and wavefunction/density units. Also repaired the digest concerns: |F2 psi|^2 is a frequency density, the momentum marginal requires Jacobian (2 pi hbar)^-1, and Tonelli is applied to Borel representatives with Borel-null envelopes proving a.e. slice independence. Maximal domains, PVMs, spectra, atomlessness, joint-position uniqueness and mixture density are retained.

The page includes the conditional uniqueness of a preparation from all exact bounded-observable laws, so denying every state-determination claim contradicted its supplier. Qualified the physical scope and body to exclude determination from finite empirical data, and explicitly retained model-internal uniqueness. Also corrected the repeated Fourier-density shorthand to the scaled frequency marginal; no empirical observation or sampling precision is introduced.

The tail cutoff and power law did not declare a coordinate reading unit. Specified numerical metre coordinates, the pair (Q1,m), the one-metre cutoff, and amplitude/moment units without changing the profile or integrals. Chose a Borel transverse representative for Tonelli. The normalized |g|^2 tail is |t|^-3: its absolute first moment is integrable, its second moment diverges, oddness gives mean zero, and the exact domain criteria imply form-domain membership but not D(Q1).

The displayed PVM gives E_A({E1,E2})=I and hence mu_rho({E1,E2})=1 for every preparation. It does not exclude null-event realizations on the declared real outcome space. Replaced every outcome with almost surely and supplied the trace-one argument in step 1.1. Two-atom probabilities, affine mixtures and finite moments/variance pq(E1-E2)^2 remain unchanged, including zero coefficient and endpoint weights.
